name: Discord Add-ons — BetterDiscord & Valenced
body:
Desktop and mobile plugins are now collected on one page, with separate sections for BetterDiscord and Valenced.

## BetterDiscord

- **Purge Tools 1.0.0** — preview, target filters, media/pinned protection, reaction cleanup, adaptive pacing, account-specific checkpoints, and direct right-click access.
- **Quick Mock 1.0.0** — right-click Mock, typed /mock, and reply /mock. Review in the composer by default; immediate menu sending is optional.
- **Hidden Channels 1.0.0** — locked channel rows and cached metadata with channel-info views, category collapse, and unchanged server permissions.
- Install the attached .plugin.js file for each plugin, or use **PurgeTools-BetterDiscord-1.0.0.zip** / **BetterDiscord-Mock-HiddenChannels-1.0.0.zip**.
- Existing configuration is retained when updating.

## Valenced

- **Purge Tools 0.1.1** — the accepted mobile port, with confirmation before each new/resumed job and no top confirmation banner.
- **Settings Pins 0.1.1** — saved pins work with Developer Mode off; optional discovery and shortcut hiding remain available in Developer Mode.
- **Quick Mock 0.1.0** — long-press Mock, typed `/mock`, reply `/mock`, direct chat input, and optional immediate sending (OFF by default). Requires Coco's Command Lib 2.x from Valenced's community catalog.
- **Hidden Channels 0.1.0** — hidden channel rows and locally available names, with category collapse behavior and unchanged server permissions. Missing metadata cannot be reconstructed.
- Add the [Valenced repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OnlyTripleSix/discord-addons/main/clients/valenced/index.json) to the plugin manager.

## Validation

33 Purge Tools desktop checks and 36 Quick Mock/Hidden Channels desktop checks, desktop browser checks, and 88 mobile automated checks passed. Production Quick Mock and Hidden Channels bundles also passed command, hook, settings, and cleanup checks. The accepted desktop Purge Tools, Quick Mock, and Hidden Channels workflows and mobile Purge, Settings Pins, Quick Mock, and Hidden Channels were tested by the user. Not every moderation, reaction, or recovery scenario has been tested live.

The release catalog now focuses on BetterDiscord and Valenced. Legacy releases were preserved in the private workbench before removal from the active release page.

Purge operations are permanent. Discord may restrict automated or abusive activity. Use at your own risk.
